items.title: Percy Stovall Interview, 1977-12-27
items.q: you said Eddie Lang was in the band? Yeah, he lives in Slidell now.

ctx.x: But I had to stay there because I was too young, I couldn't leave. And when I made 18, you better, I hiked out, I got out. Because I never liked it. I never could work in the field. They used to whip me by picking and kiting, I couldn't do it. I'd get on my knees, my knees get sore, I'd stand on my back, get sore. I never could make it. Yeah, I never could make it. Farming wasn't for me, I don't know. I couldn't think of it. So after I got to be in Maine, where I could give orders out of there. I got to get in a…
You seem to have a pretty successful life. I was trying to get back to Slim once, on one point, the, once you got, you had the band, you got the band together, you said Eddie Lang was in the band?
Yeah, he lives in Slidell now.
